what.title: Turn on Advanced protection
what.body: Your expenses, budgets and Wealth are sealed with a key only your devices hold.
what.shared: Shared expenses and projects stay visible to the server and the people in them.
what.backups: Amounts in older backups stay for 30 days.

newPassword.title: Set a new password
newPassword.body: This password unlocks your data. We cannot reset it.
